# KINX Linear Modules

> Factory-direct linear modules from Dongguan, Guangdong, China. Ball screw, belt-driven, slide table and multi-axis systems. Published positioning accuracy ±0.01 mm, repeat accuracy 0.003–0.01 mm, stroke to 500 mm. Design solution in about 6 hours, delivery in as little as 24 hours. Inquiry only — no cart, no public prices.

## What this company makes

- KK series single-axis modules: KK50 (KK5002), KK60 (KK6005 / KK6010 / KK6020), KK86 (KK8610 / KK8620), KK100 (KK10020 (expected early 2026)).
- Ball screw, belt-driven and embedded (slide table) drives.
- Multi-axis systems assembled from single axes; 68 mm dual-station bodies.
- Custom stroke: KK60 20–810 mm, KK86 50–1310 mm. KK50 is standard strokes only.
- Accuracy grades: C-grade and P-grade; P-grade repeat accuracy reaches ±0.003 mm.
- Mounting dimensions match equivalent THK SKR / KR, PMI KM and MISUMI C-KS sizes. Dimensions are confirmed on the customer's drawing before order.

## How to buy

No cart and no published prices. Send stroke (mm), load and orientation, speed, accuracy, environment and duty cycle; KINX returns a drawing and a price. Design solution in about 6 hours; delivery in as little as 24 hours on stock-based builds.
